en_title: A Famous GTA 4 Meme Is Now a Mechanic in GTA 6
subtitle: 踏板车兄弟来送车
opus_summary: 《GTA6》玩家可通过应用召唤车辆，名称致敬《GTA4》的「踏板车兄弟」名梗。NPC送车后会搭乘踏板车离开，这是系列单人模式首次无需作弊即可召车。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 has named one of its biggest mechanics after a beloved GTA 4 meme.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》用《GTA4》中一个广受喜爱的梗，为游戏的一项重要机制命名。

paragraphs.en: In 2008, a Justin.tv channel (now known as Twitch) by the name of FourPlayerPodcast made GTA history. One of the hosts of the channel, Brad Simons, rode a moped around GTA 4's Liberty City. He eventually found another moped rider and began comically declaring them "scooter brothers." The video has over 7.5 million views on YouTube , and now it's part of GTA 6.
paragraphs.cn: 2008年，Justin.tv（现名Twitch）上一个名为FourPlayerPodcast的频道，在《GTA》历史上留下了一笔。频道主持人之一Brad Simons骑着轻便摩托车，在《GTA4》的自由城里四处转悠。他最终遇到了另一名骑手，开始滑稽地高喊两人是「踏板车兄弟」。这段视频在YouTube上的播放量已超过750万次，如今，这个梗也成了《GTA6》的一部分。

paragraphs.en: In a new preview from Edge magazine , it was confirmed that players will be able to summon their vehicle using an app called Scooter Brothers. An NPC will deliver your car and then get on a scooter (presumably driven by another "brother") and drive off. Whether or not these so-called scooter brothers will have their own silly lines to honor their origins remains to be seen.
paragraphs.cn: Edge杂志的最新前瞻确认，玩家可以使用名为「踏板车兄弟」（Scooter Brothers）的应用召唤自己的车辆。一名NPC会把车送来，然后坐上踏板车离开（想必由另一位「兄弟」驾驶）。这些所谓的踏板车兄弟是否也会说些搞笑台词，致敬这个梗的起源，目前还不得而知。

paragraphs.en: In GTA 5, when switching to Trevor, players would have a chance of seeing the wily character recreating the meme with a frightened NPC. It was a pretty great nod, and now, Rockstar is keeping the tradition alive, though this time with more purpose.
paragraphs.cn: 在《GTA5》中，玩家切换到崔佛时，有机会看到这个狡黠的角色和一名惊恐的NPC重现这个梗。那次致敬相当精彩，如今Rockstar延续了这一传统，不过这次还赋予了它更多实际用途。

paragraphs.en: GTA Online has had a mechanic to let you call your car since launch, and Red Dead Redemption also allows you to summon your horse if it's within a reasonable distance. However, this is the first time players will be able to do something like this without cheats in GTA's single-player. It's arguably more necessary than ever, too, as the player's arsenal of weapons and some other important gear is stored in the trunk of their vehicle. It also means your cars likely won't be as disposable as they were in previous games.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA Online》自上线起就有召唤车辆的机制，《荒野大镖客：救赎》也允许玩家在距离不太远时召唤自己的马匹。不过，在《GTA》系列的单人模式中，玩家还是第一次能不靠作弊实现类似操作。可以说，玩家也比以往更需要这个功能，因为玩家的武器和其他一些重要装备都存放在车辆后备厢里。这也意味着，玩家很可能不会再像前几作那样随意丢弃自己的车。

paragraphs.en: All of this news comes just three weeks ahead of GTA 6's launch and two weeks before pre-loading begins. Rockstar's marketing efforts are ramping up across the globe . Rumors also indicate a PC version of the game is just around the corner, with a reported release window of early 2027 . Either way, it's an exciting time to be a GTA fan.
paragraphs.cn: 这些消息传出时，距离《GTA6》发售仅剩三周，距离开启预载还有两周。Rockstar正加大全球各地的宣传力度。另有传闻称，PC版也已不远，据称将于2027年初推出。无论如何，对《GTA》粉丝而言，这都是令人兴奋的时刻。
